source_integrity.duplicate_code_result: Unique common TBD identity; OOB variant documents standard 0x46 mechanics.

source_snapshot.procedure: During Test TBD; generic clear-logs pre-step.

historical_reviews.related_source_cases: OOB review establishes standard read-only App 0x06/0x46 and fixed-width decoding.
historical_reviews.v3_1: ED-34 treats user scope/reference as Project readiness once core read is known.

original_test_intent: Read the name of one approved BMC user ID and compare fixed-width decoded identity with the Project account baseline without changing account state.
original_method: Use Project-selected protected transport and standard App 0x06/0x46 for a finite approved user scope, with fixed-width/padding decode, redaction and no setters.
manual_activity: Security owner supplies the approved user-ID scope and expected identity/redaction policy; the package performs bounded reads and decoding.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correct for literal TBD, but related reviewed evidence identifies a safe standard read after Project inputs.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Protected raw 0x06 0x46 <approved user ID> with exact fixed-width parser and no setters.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Read only approved user IDs, validate completion/length, decode fixed-width/padded name, redact and compare to identity/access/audit baseline.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds standards-based Review guidance without modifying Master.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Only selected users/transport covered; no rename coverage.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Wrong ID or decoding can expose/misattribute security identities.

project_override_considerations: IB/OOB/vendor readers are acceptable with equivalent user-ID and raw-name evidence; record transport and unqueried accounts.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master identifies the read but leaves method, user scope and criteria TBD and asks to clear security logs; Review guidance must preserve that source gap.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Standard 0x46 resolves the core read; user scope, parser/reference and redaction are Project readiness inputs.

review_improvement: Avoids permanently blocking a defined read while preventing unbounded identity enumeration and wrong fixed-width decoding.
independent_technical_reasoning: Get User Name has deterministic read-only semantics and reviewed 0x46 mechanics. The main unresolved items are authorized scope and expected identity, which warrant a package/input classification rather than BLOCKED or unattended enumeration.
